sources.title: Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting
sources.locator: Sections 2.5.1 deleted records, 3.3.2 UTC datestamps, 3.4 metadataPrefix, 3.5 flow control/resumption tokens, and Identify response.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official specification and read section 2.5.1 directly; reviewed the adjacent concepts and section index. No collection endpoint was queried.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Identify declares deletedRecord=no, transient, or persistent. With no deletion tracking, an incremental harvester cannot discover vanished records. Persistent means deletion state is retained consistently; transient has no persistence guarantee. Follow repository datestamp granularity, metadataPrefix, and resumption-token behavior.
sources.applicability: Supports the investigator's conditional OAI design and warns against treating missing incremental results as deletions. Does not establish any pilot collection's OAI support.

sources.title: DPLA Hub Network
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current official program page; no release version/date displayed.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved the official page text via web search. No hub was contacted.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DPLA describes Content and Service Hubs as organizations that aggregate metadata from partner cultural heritage institutions and contribute it to DPLA.
sources.applicability: Supports the hub-mediated comparator only; it does not establish acceptance, partner terms, or suitability for the museum network.

sources.title: DPLA API Field Reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current official field reference; states that the DPLA API implements MAP 3.1.
sources.locator: MAP introduction; originalRecord, sourceResource.rights, object.rights, and provider fields.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved the official page text via web search; a direct open returned HTTP 403. No DPLA item/API request was made.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The field reference distinguishes rights held in the described SourceResource from rights asserted in the digital object at object.@id, and defines originalRecord as the complete provider record.
sources.applicability: Supports retaining original and mapped fields separately and scope-aware comparison. It does not describe the five source records.

sources.title: DPLA Metadata Application Profile landing page and metadata policy
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current official page; text says current MAP version 4.0 and offers a MAP 5.0 download.
sources.locator: Download the DPLA Metadata Application Profile; page's current-version label; Digital Public Library of America Policy Statement on Metadata, especially partners' terms and free reuse.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved official page text via web search; no profile artifact was downloaded.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DPLA states partners agree that metadata is broadly shareable and dedicate partner metadata that may be copyright-protected to CC0; it also states DPLA asserts no rights over its database/contributions. The same page's 4.0 current-version statement and 5.0 download offer are conflicting signals.
sources.applicability: A condition on the DPLA partner route and a concrete metadata-terms example, not a legal rule or permission for this network. It exposes a version ambiguity relevant to any future adapter.

sources.title: Europeana Semantic Elements to EDM migration guidance
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official ESE guidance page; posted 2014-12-04, updated 2023-11-06 per the page index.
sources.locator: Default ESE-to-EDM mapping and direct source-to-EDM mapping guidance; dc:date and dc:format ambiguity examples.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved the official source text via web search. A direct open redirected to an inaccessible Europeana Atlassian page; the search-returned text is the evidence used.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The default mapping may put digitization date into edm:ProvidedCHO or confuse source-object and digital-file format; provider-specific mappings can be used and direct EDM mapping is recommended for a more complete redesign.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's per-collection schema/mapping validation. This is historic guidance, not proof the five collections use ESE/EDM.

sources.title: Europeana Licensing Framework
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official framework page posted 2015-02-06 and updated 2026-05-01.
sources.locator: Metadata published by Europeana; Data Exchange Agreement; edm:rights field.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved current official Europeana page text via web search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Europeana says metadata received from providers is published under CC0 under its provider framework; edm:rights communicates terms for previews and digital objects.
sources.applicability: Supports the distinction between metadata terms and object/preview rights and the need to identify provider conditions. It does not license this network's metadata.

sources.title: RightsStatements.org: Other rights statements
sources.locator: CNE, UND, NKC definitions and collection-level introduction.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved official source text via web search; direct open returned HTTP 526.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CNE is for an unevaluated unknown; UND follows an unsuccessful evaluation; NKC requires reasonable cause to believe copyright/related rights no longer cover the work and is excluded when no inquiry occurred. These are statements, not licenses.
sources.applicability: Supports keeping absent data distinct from source-supplied CNE/UND/NKC. Does not authorize the network to assign these terms.

sources.title: Creative Commons public-domain tools
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current official CC guidance; CC0 and Public Domain Mark 1.0 tools.
sources.locator: CC0 vs. PDM; use restrictions; PDM not for uncertain or jurisdiction-specific status.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved official CC page text via web search. No tool was applied to an item.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CC0 is a tool for creators/rightsholders to waive rights they hold; PDM is an informational label for work already believed free of known copyright restrictions worldwide and is not for uncertain/jurisdiction-specific cases.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's distinction between supplied CC0 and PDM assertions. The critic makes no independent status finding.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Presentation API 3.0.0, listed as latest stable version by the official specification.
sources.locator: requiredStatement, rights, provider; machine-actionable and user-readable URI notes.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved official version-3.0 specification text via web search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: requiredStatement is user-facing text that clients must render; rights is informative and may be rendered. Rights URIs are machine-actionable HTTP URIs; equivalent HTTPS pages may be used for user links.
sources.applicability: Supports optional presentation and statement-link patterns, not harvesting/search/update. A rights value applies to the IIIF resource where attached.

sources.title: W3C SKOS Reference
sources.locator: Section 10 mapping properties; exactMatch and closeMatch semantics and transitivity.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved the official W3C text via web search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: exactMatch denotes high-confidence interchangeability and is transitive; closeMatch is not transitive. owl:sameAs asserts identity, not a weaker concept mapping.
sources.applicability: Supports versioned explicit crosswalks that preserve source URIs; does not itself establish that any two pilot terms match.

sources.title: DPLA ingestion3 Issue 739 NARA audit and deletion fix
sources.locator: Pinned README_NARA.md history and preprocessing sections; commit patch to delete-file preprocessing and zero-delete checks.
sources.observed_operation: Opened pinned GitHub commit and README; read the diff showing NaidsList rosters are not delete files and NAC_DESC_Deletes files are. No code was downloaded or run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The pinned runbook says the prior path misclassified rosters, and affected deletions may remain; correction selects explicit delete-file names and asks operators to inspect zero/invalid outcomes. Retroactive processing is a team decision.
sources.applicability: Supports the bounded history example and proposed counted-delete controls. It is a source/runbook account, not independently reproduced production behavior.

sources.title: RightsStatements.org statement applicability guidance
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official RightsStatements.org guidance posted 2018-12; no versioned revision stated in retrieved page.
sources.locator: Sections for in-copyright statements, no-copyright statements, and Other statements; comparison of original work and digital object applicability.
sources.observed_operation: Retrieved the official page content via web search. It specifically enumerates which statement families apply to both work and digital object versus only the digital object.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applicability differs by statement: some in-copyright and no-copyright terms apply only to digital objects, while the Other statements CNE/UND/NKC and several terms apply to both work and digital copy.
sources.applicability: Directly supports C1. Preserve scope as a distinct source/mapping field and do not generalize from a statement label.
